name: agents
description: Build AI systems. Agents: loop-design-check, agent-architecture-audit, autoresearch-agent, cli-for-agents, writing-for-agents and llm-friendly-context, model-router. Skills and servers: skill-creator, mcp-builder, harvest and book-to-skill. Fleets: herdr-orchestrator, herdr-worker, herdr-atomic and herdr-setup run a multi-agent worker fleet through the horch CLI. Models: decide whether to fine-tune, build the eval harness first, curate datasets, LoRA/QLoRA, preference optimisation, GRPO/RLVR, checkpoint promotion, and RAG and recommender pipeline design. skill-creator and mcp-builder are owned copies of Apache-2.0 skills from anthropics/skills; vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
